root_cause: The existing logic does not handle cases where there are unbalanced angle brackets or no angle brackets at all. It only considers the condition where `>` count can exceed `<` during the loop but not when `<` can remain unbalanced after loop completion.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Validate Non-zero Counts Modify the final condition to ensure counts of `<` and `>` are not zero:

```java
if bool and cnta == cntb and cnta != 0:
  print("Yes")
else:
  print("No")
```
This will handle cases where the input string has no angle brackets or unbalanced pairs correctly.
